Not published.** Marianne Alto · Mayor · incumbent (held City office 2022–26). **Third pass, 2 Sep 2026**, against **The Program — A City That Works v1.10 (31 Jul 2026; M39 struck 1 Sep 2026)** using the 12-topic template and Decision 14. **The letter on this card is a dash.** An internal proposal sits at the bottom and is Joa's to apply or reject. Incumbent rule: a sourced miss caps the cell below Close (max Partial+ 1.5). **Material correction — a 2026 campaign site exists.** Earlier passes recorded “no 2026 platform page” and treated [altomayor.ca](https://altomayor.ca/) as the only site. **That was wrong.** Her 2026 campaign site is [**electalto.ca**](http://electalto.ca/) — “Re-Elect Marianne Alto”, slogan **“Experience that Delivers.”** — listed as her campaign URL on her [VoteMate profile](https://en.votemate.org/bc2026/candidates/13288?riding=804). It resolves **only over ****`http://`**; the `https://` host is robots-disallowed, which is why two passes missed it. It carries a bylined **16 Aug 2026 op-ed** with a costed breakdown of safety spending — the single most useful 2026 document on this candidate. **The platform itself is still unreleased:** the `/policies` page has three thematic headings and, under each, the literal line **“Check back later for the full platform release!”**, with nominations already open. Also note: unlike her 2022 site, **the homepage carries no “authorized by / financial agent” line**. **Pass history.** Pass 1 scored the 20–21 May launch coverage only → **n=7, proposed D**. Pass 2 added Jan–Aug 2026 City releases and council coverage → n=21. **Pass 3 (this one)** adds [electalto.ca](http://electalto.ca), the 16 Aug op-ed, the Tenant Protection During Redevelopment Bylaw, the Code of Conduct Bylaw and independent-investigator model, the 2026 tax-notice capital lines, the Douglas bus lanes, the childcare zoning amendments, the Esquimalt 13.67% cost share, and the Livable CRD / VoteMate status → **n=26, proposed C**. Two rule corrections carried from pass 2: **(a)** a Record line contradicting no 2026 promise is `📋 Record`, shown and excluded from n, per the template; **(b)** a named Alto vote or motion inside the 2022–26 term is position evidence under Q1 (Commits if it does the measure's work, Disagrees if it does the opposite), while her *spoken* words score only from 2026.
